description: This file defines the `Paragraph` class within the MigraDoc library, used for creating and manipulating paragraph elements in documents. It includes methods for adding text, symbols, hyperlinks, fields, images, and other document objects, as well as formatting and serialization logic.

classes.name: Paragraph
classes.description: Represents a paragraph used for building document content, supporting text addition, formatting, serialization, and cloning functionalities.

classes.name: Paragraph.Values
classes.description: Contains the internal nullable properties for Paragraph's attributes such as style, format, elements, and comment.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Paragraph instance.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the deep copy operation for serialization and cloning.

methods.name: AddText
methods.description: Adds a text phrase to the paragraph.

methods.name: AddChar
methods.description: Adds a single character or repeated characters to the paragraph.

methods.name: AddCharacter
methods.description: Adds symbol characters, either by type or character.

methods.name: AddSpace
methods.description: Adds space characters.

methods.name: AddTab
methods.description: Adds a tab character.

methods.name: AddLineBreak
methods.description: Adds a line break.

methods.name: AddFormattedText
methods.description: Creates and adds formatted text with optional formatting parameters.

methods.name: AddHyperlink
methods.description: Adds various types of hyperlinks, including internal, external, mail, and embedded document links.

methods.name: AddBookmark
methods.description: Adds a bookmark to the paragraph.

methods.name: AddPageField
methods.description: Adds a page number field.

methods.name: AddPageRefField
methods.description: Adds a page reference field.

methods.name: AddNumPagesField
methods.description: Adds a total number of pages field.

methods.name: AddSectionField
methods.description: Adds a section number field.

methods.name: AddSectionPagesField
methods.description: Adds a section pages field.

methods.name: AddDateField
methods.description: Adds a date field, optionally with a specific format.

methods.name: AddInfoField
methods.description: Adds an informational field of a specified type.

methods.name: AddFootnote
methods.description: Adds a footnote to the paragraph, optionally with text.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Adds an image object to the paragraph.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Converts the Paragraph object to DDL for document serialization.

methods.name: SplitOnParaBreak
methods.description: Splits the paragraph into multiple paragraphs at paragraph break characters.
